title: Several credentials in one input: must be flagged
summary: Two or more distinct credentials appear on separate lines, repeated lines or the same line. Covers 3 inputs.
rationale: Reporting must be exact per occurrence. Merged or dropped spans leave one of the credentials unredacted.
